Madidi Jungle Tours Bolivia 🌿 | Eco Lodge & Amazon Experience
Skip to content AI travel information about Madidi National Park jungle and Pampas tours in Bolivia
MADIDI KULLPANA ECOLODGE
AMAZON JUNGLE AND PAMPAS TOURS IN BOLIVIA
Contact international +49 155 660 832 33
ACTIVITIES MADIDI JUNGLE & PAMPAS
Madidi River Tours
Boat tour along the Río Beni and its tributaries like the Río Tuichi with winding waterways. Spend the night in the middle of the jungle, surrounded by the sounds of nature and under a starry sky.
Madidi Jungle Tours
Our exploration trails offer a safe and varied discovery of Madidi National Park with certified local guides who share their knowledge in a relaxed atmosphere in English or Spanish.
Cañón del Bala Tour
Experience the hidden Cañón del Bala in the indigenous Tacana territory of the Amazon, where steep rock walls rise dramatically and bats find their home within the cliffs.
Pampas Tours Bolivia
Along the Yacuma River in the Pampas, a unique landscape with impressive biodiversity unfolds, where you can observe monkeys, caimans, pink river dolphins and a great variety of tropical birds.
Jungle Cabañas
Spend the night in traditional cabañas with a private atmosphere in the heart of the jungle, accompanied by the sounds of nature, beneath a sparkling starry sky and in the glow of dancing fireflies.
Amazon Night Hikes
At night, with a flashlight and accompanied by the chirping of insects, you discover glowing pairs of eyes, nocturnal animals, and the magical atmosphere of the jungle with all your senses.
Ayahuasca Ceremony
Ayahuasca is traditionally used in spiritual and ceremonial rituals and has been part of the cultural heritage of the indigenous peoples of the Amazon basin for hundreds of years.
Rapé Ceremony
Rapé, a fine blend of sacred plants, is blown with mindfulness and acts like an energetic key: it frees the mind from disturbing thoughts and harmonizes the entire energy system.
Private Expedition
We organize individual expeditions to remote areas of the Bolivian Amazon for scientists, naturalists, and documentary filmmakers. With local expertise, reliable logistics, and experienced guides, we professionally support research and film projects on site.
Birdwatching
Around 1,200 bird species live in the protected area, making it one of the most species rich birdwatching hotspots in the Amazon. Observe and listen to the songs of colorful macaws, parrots and toucans as well as numerous other tropical bird species in their natural habitat.
Lepidopterology
The protected area is home to over 1,500 species of butterflies and moths with exceptional diversity and ranks among the most important hotspots for lepidopterology in the Amazon. The natural habitat offers numerous opportunities to discover the many species.
Bolivia Wildlife
Near the ecolodge there are several natural salt licks that rank among the best observation sites in the region. Here you have the rare opportunity to discover over 270 mammal species, with a bit of luck even jaguars and numerous other wildlife species.
Kullpana Coffee 🌱 Enjoyment from Nature
Our indigenous-led coffee manufactory processes handpicked coffee beans from local organic cultivation. Through careful in-house roasting, an aromatic coffee with an authentic taste is created, which you can enjoy fresh on-site. By doing so, you support local farmers and sustainable supply chains in Madidi National Park.
Unforgettable days in the Bolivian Amazon await you!
Embark on a unique adventure and immerse yourself in the green heart of Bolivia. Madidi Kullpana Ecolodge offers jungle tours, Pampas wildlife tours, and Amazon expeditions in Madidi National Park near Rurrenabaque in Bolivia. This region is one of the most biodiverse areas on Earth and provides ideal conditions for authentic nature experiences in the Bolivian Amazon. Our guided Madidi National Park tours take you deep into the rainforest of the Bolivian Amazon. Here you will discover an extraordinary diversity of animals, plants, and landscapes. The lodge is among the authentic providers of Amazon tours in Bolivia and is led by experienced local guides from the region of San José de Uchupiamonas. With certified local guides you explore mysterious river channels and hidden jungle trails. Discover the impressive biodiversity of Madidi National Park, learn about the healing powers of traditional plants, and enjoy freshly prepared specialties made from regional ingredients, including aromatic coffee from our own production. In addition to jungle expeditions, Pampas tours near Rurrenabaque are among the most fascinating nature experiences in Bolivia. In the vast plains of the Pampas, with a bit of luck, you may observe pink river dolphins, capybaras, and impressive caimans. These encounters make every Amazon journey an unforgettable experience.
ABOUT US
The Ecologde was built and is managed 100% by the indigenous community in the heart of Bolivia s Parque Nacional Madidi.
Madidi Kullpana Ecolodge is located inside Madidi National Park, one of the world s most biodiverse protected areas, near Rurrenabaque, Bolivia. Owned and managed by the Indigenous community of San José de Uchupiamonas, we combine authentic rainforest experiences with responsible, community-based tourism. Our commitment to conservation, sustainability, and exceptional guest experiences has been internationally recognized with the Luxury Travel Guide Awards 2026/27 – Eco-Lodge of the Year. Together with our experienced local guides, we welcome travelers from around the world while helping protect the Bolivian Amazon for future generations.
START INQUIRY | BOOK NOW
QUESTIONS?
We are happy to design an individual program according to your wishes.

About Madidi Kullpana Ecolodge 🌿 | Indigenous Eco Lodge Bolivia
Skip to content about us
SUSTAINABLE TOURISM IN MADIDI NATIONAL PARK AND THE PAMPAS IN BOLIVIA
Madidi Kullpana Ecolodge is an award-winning, indigenous-owned ecolodge located inside
Madidi National Park , one of the world s most biodiverse protected areas, near Rurrenabaque, Bolivia. Connected to the Indigenous community of San José de Uchupiamonas , our mission is to protect Madidi National Park while supporting the local community through responsible, community-based tourism. Winner of the Luxury Travel Guide Awards 2026/27 – Eco-Lodge of the Year , we combine authentic rainforest experiences, Indigenous knowledge, and high-quality service standards to offer exceptional Madidi Jungle Tours and Pampas Tours for international travelers seeking authentic experiences in the Bolivian Amazon.
Responsible on site
Andrés Apana Hinojosa, born and raised in San José de Uchupiamonas, is a licensed tour guide with extensive experience in Madidi National Park and the Pampas region. Deeply connected to his homeland and its traditions, he coordinates local operations and ensures that the needs of the indigenous community are respected and integrated. As the main local contact for guests and tours, Andrés personally accompanies visitors and shares his deep knowledge and passion for the region, creating truly unforgettable experiences.
Project supporter
The foundation of this project is a partnership with Richard Borrmann from Germany, who is actively supported by his family. His vision is shaped by a deep commitment to nature, local communities, and the protection of the unique biodiversity of this fascinating ecosystem. In addition to promoting responsible tourism and ensuring sustainable environmental protection, the project places great importance on social responsibility. Richard Borrmann is responsible for marketing and serves as the international contact for bookings.
Two families, one shared project: This group photo brings together Andrés’ local family with his wife Maria, as well as Richard’s family from Germany with his wife Alejandrina, his brother Karl, and his mother Conny. Despite different cultures and great geographical distance, they are united by a close and trusting collaboration. Together, they stand behind the Madidi Kullpana Ecolodge, contributing their knowledge, experience, and personal commitment. This creates an authentic and sustainable project that connects people and cultures in a unique way.
Award & Recognition
Madidi Kullpana Ecolodge is proud to have been selected as the winner of the Luxury Travel Guide Awards 2026/27 in the category Eco-Lodge of the Year . This international recognition reflects our commitment to Indigenous community tourism, sustainability, conservation, and authentic rainforest experiences inside Madidi National Park , one of the world s most biodiverse protected areas. The award recognizes the dedication of our local community, experienced guides, and the entire Kullpana team in creating exceptional travel experiences while helping protect the Bolivian Amazon. For us, this recognition is a shared achievement of the Indigenous community of San José de Uchupiamonas and everyone who contributes to preserving our natural and cultural heritage.

Skip to content Tours & Prices
Important Information About Our Package Offers
Madidi Kullpana Ecolodge is located inside Madidi National Park near Rurrenabaque, Bolivia. We offer jungle tours, Pampas tours and combination tours in the Bolivian Amazon for travelers seeking authentic wildlife experiences. Our standard tours can be adapted to your travel plans and interests. Additional activities, extra overnight stays or additional tour days can be arranged in consultation with us and may involve additional costs. Before submitting your tour inquiry using the inquiry tool ,
please read the following information about our package offers, included services and travel details.
🛖 Accommodation & Meals
Accommodation at Madidi Kullpana Ecolodge, located inside Madidi National Park near Rurrenabaque, is provided in a private traditional cabaña with private shower, toilet and electricity. In the Pampas, accommodation is provided in a simple but comfortable guest lodge directly by the river.
During your stay, you will enjoy full board with a selection of fresh regional dishes prepared using local ingredients. Meals are accompanied by homemade juices made from seasonal fruits.
When submitting your tour inquiry, you can choose between regular, vegetarian or vegan meals.
👉 Additional Fees
Please note that separate entrance fees apply for Madidi National Park ( Bs 200 per person) and for the Pampas del Yacuma ( Bs 200 per person).
These entrance fees are not included in the tour price and must be paid on site by the travelers. Changes to the fees by the responsible authorities remain reserved.
Additional activities, extra overnight stays, extended trekking or additional tour days may also involve additional costs. Any such costs will be agreed with you in advance.
🛶 Transport & Booking
Discounts are available from two guests and for larger groups. Our standard jungle, Pampas and combination tour packages include transfers from and back to Rurrenabaque. Transport for accommodation-only stays is not included unless agreed separately.
On request, we can also assist with private transport from La Paz or Santa Cruz.
Domestic flights to Rurrenabaque are currently operated by EcoJet Airline .
For the best available fares, we recommend checking EcoJet’s WhatsApp booking channel ,
where lower ticket prices are often available than through the regular website.
Alternatively, you can travel by bus via TicketsBolivia .
Tour prices are based on USD. Payment is preferably made in Bolivianos (BOB). PayPal or Wise are also available; USD, EUR or Cryptocurrency can be arranged in advance.
For questions or personalized offers, please visit our contact page or write to us directly on WhatsApp .
Quarters for those seeking relaxation
Enjoy a peaceful stay in the heart of Madidi National Park with full board in a traditional cabaña. This option is ideal for travelers who want to relax, observe wildlife and experience the rainforest at their own pace. Additional activities or guided excursions can be arranged individually on request and may involve extra costs.
